theorems.name: Submission.cmr_vr_cd_dominating_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] (m : ℕ) (a b : Fin m → Measure X), (∀ i, IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (a i)) → (∀ i, IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (b i)) → ∃ μ₀ : Measure X, IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ₀ ∧ (∀ i, a i ≪ μ₀) ∧ ∀ i, b i ≪ μ₀
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
